apis.name: Open-Meteo Weather API
apis.summary: Global weather forecasts and historical weather data through a JSON API with no API key required for non-commercial use.
apis.description: Open-Meteo provides forecast, current conditions, historical weather, air quality, geocoding, and related environmental data. Its free hosted API is intended for non-commercial use; commercial use and higher request volumes require a subscription. Attribution is required for the underlying CC BY 4.0 data.
apis.pricingSummary: Free for non-commercial use within published fair-use limits; commercial use and higher volumes require a subscription. CC BY 4.0 attribution is required.

authMethods.details: No API key or sign-up is required for the public non-commercial forecast API.

apis.name: NASA Open APIs
apis.summary: A collection of NASA data APIs covering astronomy, Earth science, space weather, and related public datasets.
apis.description: NASA's API portal provides developer access to selected NASA datasets and services. A key is available for regular use; the portal also provides a lower-limit DEMO_KEY for exploration. Limits can vary by service, and the portal documents a default key limit of 1,000 requests per hour.
apis.pricingSummary: The portal offers developer API keys; no general API price is stated here. Request limits apply and vary by service.

authMethods.details: Register for an api.data.gov key for regular use. DEMO_KEY is available for exploration with lower limits.

sources.title: NASA Open APIs portal
sources.notes: API catalogue, authentication guidance, key registration, and service-specific documentation.

apis.name: GitHub REST API
apis.summary: REST endpoints for accessing GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, users, actions, and other platform resources.
apis.description: The GitHub REST API exposes GitHub platform resources over HTTP. Some public endpoints can be used without authentication; authenticated requests unlock additional endpoints and generally receive higher primary rate limits. Token permissions depend on the endpoint.
apis.pricingSummary: No separate API price is asserted here; access and rate limits depend on authentication method, endpoint, and account context.

authMethods.details: Personal access tokens, GitHub App tokens, and workflow GITHUB_TOKEN can be sent in the Authorization header. Some public endpoints do not require authentication.

sources.notes: REST API overview and endpoint reference.

apis.name: Open Library APIs
apis.summary: Public APIs for searching and retrieving book, author, edition, work, subject, and library catalogue data.
apis.description: Open Library exposes bibliographic data in JSON, YAML, and RDF/XML formats. Its usage guidance prioritizes human-facing discovery and lookup, asks clients to cache responses and identify their application, and discourages bulk harvesting or use as high-traffic commercial infrastructure.
apis.pricingSummary: No general commercial pricing claim is made. Usage is subject to Open Library's published fair-use and rate-limit guidance.

authMethods.details: Public catalogue search and lookup endpoints are available without authentication; account-specific endpoints may require authentication.

sources.title: Open Library
sources.notes: Public book discovery and catalogue service.

apis.name: Frankfurter Exchange Rates API
apis.summary: Free exchange-rate API covering 228 currencies with daily updates and historical rates dating back to 1948.
apis.description: Frankfurter provides latest, historical, and time-series exchange rates sourced from central banks and official institutions. Its public API requires no API key and the project is open source.
apis.pricingSummary: Public API is free to use and does not require an API key; the project can also be self-hosted.

authMethods.details: No API key or authentication is required for public exchange-rate endpoints.

sources.title: Frankfurter exchange rates API
sources.notes: Documents supported currencies, public base URL, no-key access, historical data, and open-source availability.
